title: drypetes mildbraedii
intro: Drypetes mildbraedii, commonly known as African star apple, is a plant species belonging to the family Phyllanthaceae. The African star apple has been traditionally used in West African countries for various medicinal purposes, including treating fever, diarrhea, and other gastrointestinal issues. Studies have shown that the plant has several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in protecting against oxidative stress, inflammation, and infections. The bioactive constituents of the African star apple include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, antipyretic, and antidiarrheal effects.
